verse.verse_1: I CALL TO witness those who stand arrayed in rows,
verse.verse_2: And those who restrain by reprimanding,
verse.verse_3: And those who recite the Reminder,
verse.verse_5: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them, and the Lord of the Easts.
verse.verse_6: He decked the nearest heavens with ornaments of stars,
verse.verse_7: Protecting them against every wayward devil,
verse.verse_8: So that they are not able to listen to the angels of higher (echelons), and are pelted from all sides
verse.verse_9: And kept far away. There is perpetual punishment for them,
verse.verse_10: Except those who eavesdrop and are pursued by a shooting flame.
verse.verse_11: So ask them if they are more difficult to create, or the rest We have created? Indeed (man) We created from fermented clay.
verse.verse_12: Yet while you are filled with wonder, they just scoff;
verse.verse_13: And when they are warned they pay no heed.
verse.verse_14: When they see a sign, they laugh at it,
verse.verse_16: When we are dead and turned to dust and bones, how can we be raised again,
verse.verse_18: You say: "Yes; and you will be lowly made."
verse.verse_19: There will only be a single jerk, and they will gape,
verse.verse_20: And say: "Ah woe! This is the Day of Reckoning."
verse.verse_21: "(Yes,) this is the Day of Judgement you had called a lie."
verse.verse_22: Gather all the wicked together and their comrades, and those they had worshipped
verse.verse_23: Other than God," (the angels will be told), "then show them the way to Hell,
verse.verse_24: And detain them, for they will be questioned."
verse.verse_25: "What is the matter with you that you do not help each other?"
verse.verse_26: They will submit to questioning then,
verse.verse_27: And some of them will confront the others,
verse.verse_28: Saying: "It were you who imposed yourselves upon us."
verse.verse_29: They will say: "No, you were the ones who would not believe.
verse.verse_30: We had no power over you. In fact, you were a people rebellious.
verse.verse_31: The sentence of our Lord has come true for us. We have certainly to taste (the punishment),
verse.verse_32: For we had led you astray. In fact we ourselves were astray."
verse.verse_33: So, they will become partners in punishment.
verse.verse_34: That is how We deal with sinners.
verse.verse_35: They were those who, when it was said to them, "There is no god but God," behaved with insolence,
verse.verse_36: And said: "Should we abandon our gods for the sake of an insane poet?"
verse.verse_37: Not in the least. He has brought the truth and confirmed the other messengers.
verse.verse_38: You will indeed taste a painful punishment,
verse.verse_39: And be rewarded but only for what you had done,
verse.verse_40: Except the chosen creatures of God,
verse.verse_42: Fruits of every kind, and they will be honoured
verse.verse_45: With cups from a flowing stream being passed around,
verse.verse_47: Neither dulling the senses nor intoxicating,
verse.verse_48: And with them maidens of modest look and large lustrous eyes,
verse.verse_49: Like sheltered eggs in a nest.
verse.verse_50: Then one turned to the other in an enquiry.
verse.verse_51: Said one of the speakers: "I had a friend
verse.verse_52: Who used to say: 'Are you one of those who can testify to the truth?
verse.verse_53: (Do you think) we would be paid back our due when we are dead and reduced to dust and bones?'
verse.verse_55: He looked down and saw (his friend) in the midst of Hell.
verse.verse_56: 'By God', he said, 'you had almost ruined me.
verse.verse_57: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord I too would have been there (in Hell).
verse.verse_58: (Another will say:)"Is it true, we are not going to die
verse.verse_59: Other than our first death, and we shall not be punished?
verse.verse_60: This will indeed be great happiness.
verse.verse_61: For this the toilers should strive."
verse.verse_62: Is this better or the tree of Zaqqum
verse.verse_63: Which We have reserved as punishment for evil-doers?
verse.verse_64: It is a tree that grows at the bottom of Hell.
verse.verse_65: Its spathes are like the prickly pear.
verse.verse_66: They will eat and fill their bellies with it,
verse.verse_67: Washing it down with boiling water.
verse.verse_68: Then to Hell they will surely be returned.
verse.verse_69: They had found their fathers astray,
verse.verse_70: Yet they hasten to follow in their footsteps.
verse.verse_71: So had many an earlier people gone astray,
verse.verse_72: And We had sent admonishers to them.
verse.verse_73: Look, then how was the end of those who had been warned,
verse.verse_74: Other than the chosen creatures of God.
verse.verse_75: Noah had verily called to Us. And how gracious was He who answered (him).
verse.verse_76: We saved him and his family from the great affliction,
verse.verse_79: Peace on Noah among all men.
verse.verse_80: That is how We reward those who do good.
verse.verse_81: Surely he was among Our faithful creatures.
verse.verse_83: And Abraham indeed was of his inducement,
verse.verse_84: When he came to his Lord with a heart compliant,
verse.verse_85: When he said to his father and his people: "What is this you worship?
verse.verse_86: Why do you solicit false gods instead of God?
verse.verse_87: What do you imagine the Lord of the worlds to be?"
verse.verse_88: Then he looked up at the stars (they worshipped),
verse.verse_89: And said: "I am sick (of what you worship)!"
verse.verse_90: But they turned their backs on him and went away.
verse.verse_91: Then he turned towards their gods and said: "Why do you not eat (of these offerings)?
verse.verse_92: What is wrong with you that you do not speak?"
verse.verse_93: Then he started striking them down with his right hand.
verse.verse_94: So the people descended upon him.
verse.verse_95: "Why do you worship these you carve yourselves," he asked,
verse.verse_96: "When God has created you and what you make?"
verse.verse_97: "Build a pyre for him and throw him into the raging fire."
verse.verse_98: So they contrived a plot against him, but We made them abject.
verse.verse_99: And he said: "I am going away to my Lord who will show me the way.
verse.verse_100: (And he prayed:) "O Lord, grant me a righteous son."
verse.verse_101: So We gave him the good news of a clement son.
verse.verse_102: When he was old enough to go about with him, he said: "O my son, I dreamt that I was sacrificing you. Consider, what you think?" He replied: "Father, do as you are commanded. If God pleases you will find me firm."
verse.verse_103: When they submitted to the will of God, and (Abraham) laid (his son) down prostrate on his temple,
verse.verse_105: You have fulfilled your dream." Thus do We reward the good.
verse.verse_106: That was indeed a trying test.
verse.verse_107: So We ransomed him for a great sacrifice,
verse.verse_108: And left (his hallowed memory) for posterity.
verse.verse_110: That is how We reward those who do good.
verse.verse_111: He is truly among Our faithful creatures.
verse.verse_112: So We gave him the good news of Isaac, apostle, who is among the righteous.
verse.verse_113: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among their descendants are some who do good, but some who wrong themselves.
verse.verse_114: We were indeed gracious to Moses and Aaron,
verse.verse_115: And saved them and their people from great distress,
verse.verse_116: And helped them, so they were victorious.
verse.verse_117: We gave them the explicit Book,
verse.verse_118: And showed them the straight path,
verse.verse_120: Peace be on Moses and Aaron.
verse.verse_121: That is how We reward those who do good.
verse.verse_122: They are among Our faithful devotees.
verse.verse_123: Verily Elias is one of the apostles.
verse.verse_124: When he said to his people: "Will you not be mindful of God?
verse.verse_125: Would you call on Baal and leave the best of creators,
verse.verse_126: God, your Lord, and the Lord of your fathers?"
verse.verse_127: They denied him, and will surely be brought to punishment,
verse.verse_128: Except the chosen creatures of God.
verse.verse_129: And We left his (memory) for posterity.
verse.verse_131: That is how We reward those who do good.
verse.verse_132: He is truly among Our faithful devotees.
verse.verse_133: Verily Lot was one of the apostles,
verse.verse_134: Wherefore We saved him and his entire family
verse.verse_135: Except an old woman who was one of those who stayed behind.
verse.verse_137: You pass by (their habitations) in the morning
verse.verse_138: Or at night. Then how is it you do not understand?
verse.verse_139: Verily Jonah is one of the apostles.
verse.verse_140: When he fled on the laden ship,
verse.verse_141: And lots were cast (when a storm overtook them), he was rejected, (and thrown overboard).
verse.verse_142: Then he was swallowed by a large fish as he was worthy of blame.
verse.verse_143: Had he not been one of those who struggled hard,
verse.verse_144: He would have stayed in its belly till the day the dead are raised.
verse.verse_145: So We cast him, sick, on a barren shore,
verse.verse_146: And We made a gourd tree grow over him.
verse.verse_147: We sent him to a hundred thousand men or more,
verse.verse_148: And they came to believe; so We allowed them to enjoy the good things of life for an age.
verse.verse_149: Now ask them if their Lord has daughters, and they sons?
verse.verse_150: Or did We make the angels females, and they witnessed it?
verse.verse_151: Is it not a lie invented by them when they say:
verse.verse_152: "God has begotten (children)?" They are liars indeed!
verse.verse_153: Does He prefer sons to daughters?
verse.verse_154: What ails you that you judge in such a wise?
verse.verse_156: Or have you received some clear authority?
verse.verse_157: Then bring your scripture, if what you say is true.
verse.verse_158: They link Him with jinns by lineage, yet the jinns know they will be brought before Him.
verse.verse_159: God is too glorious for what they ascribe to Him
verse.verse_160: Except His chosen creatures who do not.
verse.verse_161: So neither you nor those you worship
verse.verse_162: Can mislead anyone away from Him,
verse.verse_163: Except one who is (destined) to burn in Hell.
verse.verse_164: "There is not one of us who does not have his appointed place," (declare the angels.)
verse.verse_165: "And we are truly those who stand in rows,
verse.verse_166: And we are those who sing hallelujas to Him."
verse.verse_168: If we had the account of earlier people with us,
verse.verse_169: We would have been the chosen creatures of God."
verse.verse_170: Yet now (that it has come) they refuse to believe in it; but they will come to know soon.
verse.verse_171: Our word had already been given before to Our votaries, the apostles, --
verse.verse_173: And that certainly Our armies will be victorious.
verse.verse_174: So you ignore them for a time
verse.verse_175: And wait; they will come to know soon.
verse.verse_176: Do they want to hasten Our punishment?
verse.verse_177: When it comes down on their plains, it will be an evil dawn for those who had been warned.
verse.verse_178: So turn away from them for a time
verse.verse_179: And watch; they will come to know soon.
verse.verse_180: Too glorious is your Lord, the Lord of power, for what they ascribe to Him.
verse.verse_181: So peace be on the messengers,
verse.verse_182: And all praise to God, the Lord of all the worlds.
